quarterly_data.quarter: Korea Zinc press release: release ea-b3-a0-eb-a0-a4-ec-95-84-ec-97-b0-eb-b (09-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor-grade sulfuric acid: Korea Zinc completed and started full operation of semiconductor sulfuric acid lines No. 20 and 21 at the Onsan smelter, adding about 40 thousand tonnes a year and lifting capacity from 280 thousand to 320 thousand tonnes a year (17 lines made 240 thousand tonnes before lines 18 and 19 were added in 2024). The expansion was made ahead of new fabs of major Korean chipmakers driven by AI infrastructure investment. The company says it supplies about 60% or more of Korean semiconductor sulfuric acid demand, sends about 95% of output to major Korean chipmakers and also supplies chipmakers in Japan and Singapore; the acid is 6N (99.9999%+) purity, refined from sulfur dioxide recovered in zinc and lead smelting.
quarterly_data.figure: semiconductor sulfuric acid capacity 320 thousand t/year (from 280 thousand); lines 20-21 add about 40 thousand t/year; about 60% of Korean demand

quarterly_data.quarter: Korea Zinc press release: release ea-b3-a0-eb-a0-a4-ec-95-84-ec-97-b0-eb-b (09-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Target: Korea Zinc plans to raise semiconductor sulfuric acid capacity in stages to up to 500 thousand tonnes a year in line with Korean chipmakers' expansion schedules, and is reviewing a semiconductor sulfuric acid line of about 100 thousand tonnes a year at its Tennessee (US) integrated smelter, which targets trial operation in 2029 and commercial production in 2030, to supply chipmakers expanding US production.
quarterly_data.figure: capacity target up to 500 thousand t/year; about 100 thousand t/year US line under review; Tennessee smelter commercial production 2030
